milestone.piece: Material reviewer consumes original-linked coverage choices and history
milestone.invariant: Material coverage can represent saved or historical interpretations only through checked original admission support for the selected source portion. Eligibility, current value, revision authority, proposal admission and requested completion stay distinct. Correction must preserve valid independent peers and full original input.
milestone.observable_pass: Explicit modern coverage_record_support derives per-attempt source-specific record/candidate choices, whole/exact extents and actual original-support admission. Historical material is a separate detached NM interpretation presentation, excluded from current and revision domains. Pending candidates use owned account domains; settled positives use actual support and settled negatives/openings cannot fill material coverage. Default None remains compatible. The full actual on_the_wire schema, prompt and output reserve fit before dispatch.
milestone.baseline: Initial28 new cases:27 absent-API failures and1 unchanged default pass. Two authored fixtures were corrected to exercise their intended invariant: non-advocate proof must refuse before dispatch; disjoint ranges must address one actual canonical source. Five older stale schema assertions fail identically against committed0373f11. An additional equal-duplicate active-row reuse case fails before presentation normalization and passes afterward.
milestone.verification: 29 focused choice/proof/extent/cache/resource cases pass.181 existing verification, quarantine, coverage/domain/isolation, source-purpose/support and actual public save/replay checks pass across the recorded runs after correcting five stale schema assertions. Behavior/model judgments in those old tests were not changed. Ruff passes. Scripted values establish mechanics only: no new pinned-model or browser calls, and the ordinary public turn has not yet supplied these new proof arguments.
milestone.prompt_change: Coverage extension now separates Message, Purpose, Look for and Outcome, original content from current/held/history interpretations, and source eligibility from checked representation. Defines explicit whole_source/exact_subrange selections only under the fresh marker. Retains all significant propositions, qualifiers, source purpose, authorised scope and legitimate partial/unassessed states without inventing completion or forcing new extraction.
milestone.canonical_changes: None. Native extents resolve through the existing shared contract to canonical ranges. Raw saved reviews, authority, locators, digests and seals are not passed as historical account evidence; historical presentation selects the existing MaterialCandidate account fields plus durable ID/source turn/state. Canonical input remains intact. Equal duplicate active rows normalize only in comparison presentation; conflicting or current/history identities refuse.
milestone.call_impact: No new routine stage. Existing material review remains1 coherent Judge call and at most1 local conditional correction under the turn-owned ledger. Coverage-only correction preserves admitted candidate decisions. No new live spend; combined measured USD2.938001 of USD5. Actual schema tokens now enter pre-dispatch context accounting without trimming the transcript.
milestone.remaining: Dispute reviewer equivalent native consumer, then ordinary and recovery turn handoffs with current/historical proofs, one shared saved-execution memo and versioned fresh capture. Public browser acceptance of complete coverage and saved/reopened effects remains required. Source reaffirmation recovery, association, neutral dispute identity/retirement, typed useful delivery, legal force/applicability/currency, UI and closure gaps remain open.
